data.name: Prabhanjan
data.short_meaning: One who can tame or destroy
data.long_meaning: Prabhanjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Prabh' which means 'to tame'. The suffix 'anjan' means 'destroyer'. This name signifies a person who can tame and destroy. It represents power, courage and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is known as Prabhanjan because he can tame and destroy the negative energies.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prabhanjan is a name that embodies the spirit of courage, wisdom and power. It is a name that inspires strength and resilience, and is a reminder of the power that lies within each one of us.
